name: STAPLEX PM10 Sampling Systems
summary: High-volume systems that collect particles of 10 µm and smaller on 8" x 10" filters for ambient air monitoring, with flow control, timing and recording options and an outdoor shelter.

specs.Description: Basic PM10 high-volume system, 230 V 50 Hz, 40 cfm (1.13 m³/min), 8" x 10" filters
Size-selective inlet (9.7 µm cut-point); converts a TSP system to PM10
Constant flow controller, 220 V, with mechanical 7-day timer and elapsed-time indicator
Flow recorder, 230 V; 24-hour record of sampler performance
Digital 7-day timer, 230 V; switches the sampler on and off at set times
Aluminium outdoor shelter for the sampler

internalNotes: FC-2LTM and MT-2 left off: FC-2LTM not found (closest is FC-2ETM); Staplex page lists MT-2 ordering text as 'MLT-2'. Confirm with Staplex.
